abstract:
OBJECTIVES: Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene homolog mutations drive over 90% of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). Direct RAS inhibitors have shown early activity, but the only prior meta-analysis pooled early-phase monotherapy cohorts and predates the first phase 3 randomized trial and newer combination regimens. We estimated the objective response rate (ORR), disease control rate (DCR), and safety of Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene homolog-targeted therapy in locally advanced or metastatic PDAC.
METHODS: PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and SCOPUS were searched from inception through July 2026. Single-arm proportions were pooled using a random-effects generalized linear mixed model; RASolute 302 was analyzed separately. Prespecified subgroups stratified ORR by mechanistic class and line of therapy.
RESULTS: A total of 1008 patients from 16 cohorts across 7 trials were included; 15 single-arm cohorts (507 patients) contributed to pooled estimates. Pooled ORR was 38.9% (95% CI: 29.9%-48.8%; I2=75.7%) and varied significantly by mechanism (P<0.0001): combination regimens showed the highest activity (60.5%), followed by G12D-selective (31.0%), pan-RAS(ON) (26.6%), and G12C-selective monotherapy (25.4%). Response declined with successive lines of therapy (P=0.0102), from 72.5% in treatment-naive patients to 32.5% after ≥3 prior lines. Pooled DCR was 87.6% (95% CI: 82.8%-91.2%). Grade ≥3 treatment-related adverse events occurred in 47.3%. In RASolute 302, daraxonrasib nearly doubled median overall survival versus chemotherapy (13.2 vs. 6.6 mo).
CONCLUSIONS: Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene homolog-directed therapy produces meaningful antitumor activity in previously treated PDAC, greatest for combination regimens and earlier treatment; the evidence remains heterogeneous and largely early-phase, and randomized trials are needed before routine adoption.
key_points_ko: KRAS 표적 치료의 전체 객관적 반응률(ORR)은 38.9%였으며 병용요법에서 60.5%, G12D 선택적 억제제에서 31.0%를 나타냈습니다.
반응률은 이전 치료 경험이 없는 환자(72.5%)에서 3차 이상 치료 환자(32.5%)로 진행될수록 감소했습니다.
3상 임상시험인 RASolute 302에서 daraxonrasib(다락소나십)은 화학요법 대비 전체 생존기간(OS) 중앙값을 13.2개월 대 6.6개월로 약 2배 연장했습니다.
전체 환자군에서 3등급 이상의 치료 관련 부작용은 47.3%에서 발생했습니다.
summary_ko: 국소 진행성 또는 전이성 췌관선암 환자를 대상으로 KRAS 표적 치료제의 치료 반응과 안전성을 평가한 체계적 문헌고찰 및 메타분석 연구입니다. 총 7건의 임상시험에서 1,008명의 환자 데이터가 분석에 포함되었습니다. 전체 객관적 반응률(ORR)은 38.9%, 질병 조절률(DCR)은 87.6%로 집계되었습니다. 특히 단독요법보다 병용요법에서, 그리고 이전 치료 차수가 적을수록 더 높은 반응률을 보였습니다.
title: Efficacy and Safety of KRAS-Targeted Therapy in Locally Advanced or Metastatic Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Pooled Proportions
title_ko: 국소 진행성 또는 전이성 췌관선암에서 KRAS 표적 치료의 유효성 및 안전성: 최신 체계적 문헌고찰 및 메타분석
